name: customers
definition: 参与加油消费活动的个人或组织，具有客户细分与结算币种等区别特征 Counterexample: 与加油站区分：加油站是提供加油服务的场所，客户是消费方 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table customers; provenance: direct source customers

name: gasstations
definition: 提供燃油销售服务的固定经营场所，具有所属连锁、国家与站点细分等区别特征 Counterexample: 与客户区分：加油站是服务提供场所，客户是消费方 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gasstations; provenance: direct source gasstations

name: products
definition: 可供销售的商品或服务项目，具有描述性标识等区别特征 Counterexample: 与交易区分：产品是被交易的对象，交易是发生的行为 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table products; provenance: direct source products

name: transactions
definition: 客户在加油站购买产品并完成支付的单次消费事件，具有时间、金额与价格等区别特征 Counterexample: 与客户区分：交易是发生的事件，客户是参与主体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table transactions_1k; provenance: direct source transactions_1k

name: yearmonth
definition: 按客户与月份汇总消费金额的信息记录，具有客户、月份与消费额等区别特征 Counterexample: 与交易区分：月度消费汇总是聚合信息记录，交易是单次事件 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table yearmonth; provenance: direct source yearmonth

name: CustomerSegment
definition: The business segment a customer belongs to (SME, LAM, KAM).

name: Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer's consumption is paid.

name: MonthlyConsumption
definition: The gas consumption recorded for a customer in a given year-month.

name: YearMonth
definition: The year-month period encoded in the Date column of yearmonth (first 4 digits year, next 2 digits month).

name: TransactionDate
definition: The date on which a transaction occurred.

name: TransactionTime
definition: The time of day at which a transaction occurred.

name: TransactionAmount
definition: The monetary amount of a transaction.

name: GasStationChain
definition: The chain to which a gas station belongs.

name: GasStationCountry
definition: The country in which a gas station is located.

name: ProductDescription
definition: The textual description of a product.

name: AnnualConsumption
definition: Total gas consumption of a customer or segment over a calendar year. Formula: SUM(MonthlyConsumption) filtered by YearMonth year. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonth = yearmonth.Date

name: PeakMonthConsumption
definition: The month with the maximum consumption for a given group and year. Formula: MAX(MonthlyConsumption) grouped by YearMonth. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonth = yearmonth.Date

name: CustomerCountOverThreshold
definition: Count of customers whose monthly consumption exceeds a threshold. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) WHERE MonthlyConsumption > 1000. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption

name: TransactionCount
definition: Number of transactions matching a filter. Formula: COUNT(TransactionID). Inputs: TransactionDate = transactions_1k.Date; GasStationCountry = gasstations.Country

name: CustomerSegment
definition: Analysis by customer business segment.

name: Currency
definition: Analysis by payment currency.
